sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.detail: committed first — timestamp above, before any market number
sections.markdown:
**Sourcing note.** KLBF primary PDFs (kalbe.co.id IR, idnfinancials) returned 403 / JS-wall to this session's fetches, so FY2025 figures below are the audited annual and H1-2026 periodic statements as carried by yfinance/stockanalysis data rows (mapping to the filed LK rows named). Division split is scouting-card-sourced; unreached figures are marked **unverified**.

**EARNINGS_QUALITY_FLAGS gate.** IDX regime: main-board large-cap (`the INDO universe`: KLBF.JK, HEALTHCARE, idr_defensive, board=main); no special-notation / papan-pemantauan-khusus status found — clean. Auditor Big-4-network, no down-tier flag (**unverified: exact audit firm**). Accruals 3y (non-financial): FY25 NI Rp3.665tn vs CFO ~Rp3.27tn (FCF Rp2.46tn + capex Rp0.81tn) → +Rp0.39tn ≈ 1.3% of avg assets ~Rp30tn — clean; FY24 negative accrual — clean. Divergence flag: FY25 receivables Rp5.65tn, +16.2% yoy vs revenue +8.3% (>1.5x; yfinance balance/income) — optics-class, watch. Inventory +7.4% vs COGS +8.1% — fine. Related-party: family-anchored (Setiawan founding family via holding vehicles); no siphon identified — **unverified: RP-% of revenue not extracted from LK note**. Structure flags: none found (no pledged-stake alarm, no serial rights issues). Action: no manipulation-class flag; optics-class items haircut → carried to pre-mortem.

**FY2025 audited actuals** (yfinance annual rows, 2025-12-31): revenue Rp35.32tn (+8.3% yoy), gross margin 39.8%, operating margin 12.9%, NI attributable Rp3.665tn (+13.1%), basic EPS Rp80.5 (avg shares 45.52bn), ROE ≈ 15.9%, net cash ≈ Rp4.19tn (cash+STI Rp4.49tn − total debt Rp0.30tn), reported FCF Rp2.46tn. **Dividend: FY2025 DPS Rp20 paid 2026-06-04 — a 44% CUT from Rp36 (FY2024); payout falls ~51%→~25%** (yfinance dividend history) — falsifies the card's "5%+ yield / 50%+ payout" premise.

**H1-2026 periodic** (yfinance quarterly rows): H1 revenue Rp19.48tn (+14.4% yoy) but NI Rp1.919tn (−2.8% yoy); TTM (Jun-26) revenue Rp37.72tn (+13.0%), NI Rp3.61tn (+5.8%) — top line strong, margin compressing (net ~9.6% TTM vs 10.4% FY25; Q2-26 gross 36.8% vs ~40%).

**Division build (FY26E),** split card-sourced (prescription ~27 / consumer-health ~17 / nutritionals ~30 / distribution ~26 of revenue, **unverified vs primary segment note**):
- Prescription (~Rp9.5tn FY25): JKN/BPJS expands volume at controlled price → rev +10%/yr, margin flat-to-down.
- Consumer health (~Rp6.0tn): squeeze easing → rev +6%/yr.
- Nutritionals (~Rp10.6tn): birth-rate decline caps infant formula → rev +3-4%/yr (price/mix, aging/adult).
- Distribution (~Rp9.2tn): tracks the pharma market → rev +8%/yr at low margin.
Blended FY26E revenue ≈ Rp39tn (+10%). **Committed EPS path:** FY26E ≈ **Rp83** (NI ≈ Rp3.75tn, net margin ~9.6% — compression roughly offsets ~10% top-line growth), FY27E ≈ **Rp90** (+9%), FY28E ≈ **Rp99** (+10%) — a single-digit CAGR, NOT the 15% historical; the cut + margin step-down are underwritten as real.

**FCF / DCF (IDR, method VAL_COMPOUNDER_QUALITY).** FCF conversion ~0.67 of NI (FY25). Owner-earnings base FY26E ≈ Rp2.5tn FCF. Fade FY27→FY35 at 9/10/8/6/5/4/3.5/3/3%; terminal g 3% ≤ long-run ID nominal GDP. **COE 11.5% (mid of house IDR 11-13% band; net-cash defensive, but BoP-pressure regime holds it above the floor).** Value: COE 11% → Rp972/sh; 11.5% → Rp919; 12% → Rp872; 13% → Rp792 (equity = DCF EV + Rp4.19tn net cash, / 45.25bn shares). **Entry Rp760 is ~13-28% below 11-11.5% COE fair value** — a real margin of safety, but upside is carried by the multiple normalizing from a panic ~9.4x FY25 (9.6x TTM) toward ~11.5x FY28E, not by heroic growth.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.detail: one sentence, from memory, written before document work
sections.markdown: What I believe the market narrative is: KLBF — Indonesia's largest, historically 20-30x defensive pharma — has been structurally de-rated to ~9-10x on a feared JKN/BPJS margin squeeze, a 44% dividend cut, and a birth-rate-driven nutritionals slowdown, and the market now treats it as a melting ex-premium consumer name rather than a net-cash compounder whose competitive position is intact.

sections.heading: Base-rate anchoring
sections.markdown: Primary archetype **derated_compounder_rerating** (0.40, +50/-30, 3y). It clears the clearance condition — "a cyclical or sentiment de-rating with intact competitive position" — because the de-rating is multiple-led (price −43% from the 1,345 52w-high while FY25 NI +13%, TTM revenue +13%), NOT local-challenger share loss: Kalbe remains #1 with 13% top-line growth and the widest GT/MT distribution reach in Indonesian pharma (method rule 6 moat). **The cross-archetype dividend_income_anchor is REJECTED**: its 0.60 window is a high-payout cash cow anchored by a well-covered dividend, and the FY2025 DPS cut to Rp20 (payout ~25%, yield ~2.6%) breaks that premise — the card's +9.0% dividend EV is a stale-premise artifact; the honest prior is the compounder class. **p_up 0.45 is +5pp over the 0.40 registry**, argued: the multiple-compression leg is largely spent (9.4x vs a 20-30x history), the balance sheet is net cash (Rp93/sh ≈ 12% of price), the cut is FCF-covered (Rp2.46tn FCF vs Rp1.64tn dividend) so it reads as discretionary capital retention, and no challenger-share evidence exists. Held to +5pp, not higher, because the margin trough has NOT yet printed (TTM NI +5.8% vs rev +13%) and the nutritionals headwind is structural. **Multiple-survival test**: target Rp1,140 implies ~11.5x FY28E EPS 99 (~12.7x FY27E 90) — below the fair range and <50% of the 10-yr average, so a rational buyer pays it; the exit multiple (11.5x) sits modestly above entry (9.4x), and that expansion is the thesis (normalization from a panic multiple), not a costume hiding no growth.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** KLBF is a structurally de-rated value trap — the 44% dividend cut proves weak cash generation, JKN/BPJS price control permanently compresses prescription margins, the birth-rate decline caps nutritionals, and the 2026 price halving (1,345→630-760) is the market correctly re-rating an ex-growth pharma to a single-digit multiple.
**Why wrong:** The market is pricing a *structural* margin collapse the statements do not yet show. FY25 NI +13% on +8.3% revenue; TTM (Jun-26) revenue +13%; ROE ~16%; net cash Rp4.19tn with FCF covering the cut dividend 1.5x — not a cash-constrained company. A ~25% payout on a net-cash balance sheet reads as retaining capital for the prescription/nutritionals build-out, not distress. The margin compression is real but mix-led (distribution + prescription volume outpacing high-margin consumer health/nutritionals) plus a JKN price-transition a #1 with the widest distribution reach is best placed to absorb. At 9.4x FY25 (ex-cash ~8.4x) the market pays under half the historical multiple for a franchise that has not lost share — a sentiment de-rating, not a structural one.
**What proves us wrong:** FY2026 audited net margin 1.5x revenue growth; or demonstrable local-challenger share gain in OTC/prescription (method rule 6).

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.detail: >=3, observable, current, each citing a dossier/filing line
sections.markdown:
1. **FY2025 dividend cut 44%**: DPS Rp36 (FY2024, paid 2025-06-04) → Rp20 (FY2025, paid 2026-06-04); payout ~51%→~25% despite NI +13% (yfinance dividend history). Contradicts the card's 5%+ yield / 50%+ payout premise; signals caution.
2. **Margin compression ongoing, not troughing**: TTM (Jun-26) NI +5.8% vs revenue +13.0% (stockanalysis TTM); Q2-26 NI Rp0.891tn ~flat YoY vs Q2-25 Rp0.898tn (yfinance quarterly); Q2-26 gross 36.8% vs ~40% FY25.
3. **Receivables divergence**: FY25 AR Rp5.65tn, +16.2% yoy, vs revenue +8.3% yoy — >1.5x revenue growth (yfinance balance/income) — working-capital flag.
4. **Nutritionals structural headwind**: ~30% of revenue is nutrition (card, **unverified vs primary**); Indonesia's secular birth-rate decline caps the infant-formula volume pool the division historically rode.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is mid-2029 and this position lost ~30%. The most likely reason: the JKN/BPJS price regime was not a transition but a permanent reset — FY26 audited net margin printed <9% and never recovered; the FY25 dividend cut proved to be the first of two (FY26 held at Rp20 or cut again), confirming management saw impaired FCF all along; consumer health pricing power never returned, and nutritionals shrank on the birth-rate decline — so EPS stayed below Rp80 through FY28 while the market held KLBF at ~7-8x, and the "cyclical de-rating" I bought was actually the structural de-rating the derated_compounder_rerating base rate warns is the trap. The kill at Rp570 (−25%, below the 52w-low zone) is wired to catch exactly this.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
(Drew appends verbatim; survives the Judge verdict — never edited by a later stage)

1. **down_pct −25 is the kill floor, not the losing mean.** Archetype base_down_pct is −30; you set −25 = loss-at-kill (570/760). Truncating the tail to the kill level understates the honest losing mean and inflates EV. Net-cash floor does not justify it — the 44% dividend cut says management sees impaired FCF.

2. **p_up 0.45 is hope, not evidence.** Registry 0.40. Your own text admits the margin trough has NOT printed (TTM NI +5.8% vs rev +13%). The +5pp rests on "compression largely spent" — but Q2-26 gross 36.8% vs ~40% FY25 shows compression accelerating, not spent. No evidence for the bump.

3. **up_pct 50 = a held-multiple re-rating bet on a name that just de-rated 43%.** Exit 11.5x vs entry 9.4x — the entire upside is multiple expansion, not growth (EPS CAGR single-digit). Betting +50% re-rating on a name the market just halved is the derated_compounder trap, not the escape.

4. **The DPS cut guts the "defensive compounder" framing.** A net-cash defensive compounder does not cut DPS 44% (Rp36→Rp20) while NI is +13%. You spin it as "discretionary retention"; the market reads it as caution. The 2.4% yield input is low and itself at risk — your own kill criterion flags a second cut.

5. **Division split is load-bearing and uncited.** Prescription 27/consumer 17/nutritionals 30/distribution 26 is card-sourced, **unverified vs primary** — yet it drives the entire FY26E revenue build and the margin-compression story. An uncited load-bearing input is an auto-KILL per rule 0. Same for RP-% and audit firm.

6. **Crowded defensive in a BoP regime.** INDO books all-cash, rate-sensitive AVOID, BI defensive. idr_defensive pharma is the obvious haven — the idea card itself calls it "deliberate sector rotation" and "completely uncovered." Everyone rotates here; the re-rating may already be priced into the 760 entry.

7. **catalyst_date null — no trigger.** A 3y value bet with no catalyst is a slow grind. What forces the market to re-rate from 9.4x to 11.5x? The only dated kill is a 2027-06-30 DPS check — a downside trip, not an upside catalyst.

8. **EV arithmetic checks** (0.45×50 + 0.55×−25 + 2.4×3 − 0.3 = 15.65 ≈ 15.7) — but 7.2 of the 15.7 is the 3y dividend stream. If the cut repeats (your own kill criterion), the 2.4% input is wrong and expected_pct collapses toward ~8.5.

9. **Anti-gaming: clean.** estimates_committed_at 13:45 precedes draft 13:51; no retro-edit; prior attack log absent (first pass). No fabrication — but the honest unverified flags do not excuse carrying the thesis on them.

**Verdict: MAJOR_REVISION.** Strongest single sentence: the trade's entire expected value rests on a +5pp p_up bump and a truncated −25 losing mean, both unsupported by a margin that is still compressing — while the load-bearing division split is uncited.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown: **KILL.** Drew's kill survives; the analyst himself concedes the dispositive point. The division split (prescription 27 / consumer-health 17 / nutritionals 30 / distribution 26) is card-sourced and **unverified** against the primary LK segment note, yet it drives the entire FY26E revenue build, the margin story, and the EPS path (Rp83→90→99) on which the valuation rests. No franchise quality — net cash Rp4.19tn, #1 GT/MT reach, FCF covering the cut dividend 1.5x — repairs that evidentiary gap; the 44% DPS cut at NI +13% cuts the other way on downside truncation, so p_up correctly stays at the 0.40 registry rate, unraised. Economics are independently sub-hurdle: +7.7%/3y ≈ +2.5%/yr against the ~7.2% FR/house equity hurdle, consistent with MUFG-001 (+2.9%/3y killed) and TOWR-001 (+15.6%/3y killed, downside pinned). Residual upside is a held-multiple re-rating (9.4x→11.5x) on a name that just de-rated 43%, with catalyst_date null — nothing forces the re-rate. Arithmetic is honest (0.40×50 + 0.60×−30 + 6.0 − 0.3 = 7.7); per T-GLOBAL-0700HK-001, correcting more negative is not gaming. Process clean: monotonic stage_log, verbatim Bear log. Kill is final; no risk/sizing routing. Resubmission requires the primary LK segment note (plus audit firm / RP-% sourced) as material new evidence.
